name: Safety Components an Elevate Textiles Company
old_description: "Since 2018, we have used Safety Components fabrics in our turnout gear, driven by the performance and durability of their outer shell and comfort of the Glide Ice liner. Our commitment to them is rooted in the enhanced safety, comfort, and wearability their materials provide. We are proud to partner with them (through our gear manufacturer) to help protect the men and women of the Indianapolis Fire Department. Safety Components' dedication to innovation, safety, service, and product education has been invaluable to us.
about:
Safety Components operates from a 22-acre campus in Greenville, South Carolina, where it has produced technical textiles since 1912. Now a subsidiary of Elevate Textiles, the company traces its roots to over a century of textile expertise in the region.

The 800,000-square-foot facility integrates weaving, coating, finishing, testing, and warehousing under one roof. Skilled associates manufacture a range of industrial fabrics — from flame-resistant outer shells and thermal liners for turnout gear to military-spec technical textiles and WeatherMAX® outdoor and marine fabrics — using substrates such as woven polyesters, nylons, and aramid fibers.

The company supplies the largest fire departments in the United States and worldwide, including the Indianapolis Fire Department, and provides materials to gear manufacturers Lion Apparel, Globe, and Honeywell. Its fabrics also serve military programs, high-performance outdoor brands, and the coating industry.

Safety Components differentiates itself through patented technologies such as Filament Twill Technology™ (2012), which yields lighter, stronger fabrics, and PF Zero™, the first commercially available PFAS-free durable water repellent finish for PPE meeting NFPA 1971. The firm also pursues sustainability targets: 100 percent renewable energy and a 40 percent water-use reduction by 2030.
